note:
Phase 11D Section 5: PRE-REGISTER the calibration-prompt-subsets used for
the calibration-set-size investigation, BEFORE any ranking, correlation, or
quality metric is computed from them. This file must be run (and its output
committed / inspected) before calibration_size_analysis.py is ever run.

Selection rule (fixed by prompt LABELS and the category order already fixed
in prompts.json since Phase 10C -- never by any Phase 11C/11D measurement):
round-robin across the 11 categories in their prompts.json order, taking
each category's train prompts in numeric-suffix order (_1 before _2).
code_reasoning has only one train prompt (code_reasoning_1) and simply drops
out of the second round. This produces a category-diverse prefix at every
size instead of exhausting one category before touching the next.

Sizes: 5, 10, 15, 21 (= the full pre-registered train set, Phase 11C's own
train/holdout split) are prefixes of this round-robin train order. Size 31
is the full 31-prompt set (all 21 train + all 10 holdout, appended in the
holdout list's own prompts.json order) -- used ONLY as a data-ceiling
reference ranking, never as a held-out-validated operational profile
(there is no held-out data left once 31 prompts are used for calibration).
selection_rule: Round-robin across the 11 categories in prompts.json's own fixed category order, train prompts only, numeric suffix _1 before _2 within each category; code_reasoning (1 train prompt) drops out after round 1. Sizes 5/10/15/21 are prefixes of this 21-element order; size 31 appends the 10 holdout prompts (in prompts.json's fixed holdout order) after all 21 train prompts.
